Package org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.support.audit.model

package org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.support.audit.model
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BalpAuditEvent
    Base class of the AuditEvents built along the conventions of IHE BALP: the agent slices for the client and the server of a transaction, the user agent of the access token it carried, the audit source, and the entities for the patient, the data and the query.
    BalpAuditEventHelper
    What is needed to build a BALP AuditEvent but is not itself part of a BALP profile: reading the ATNA AuditMessage of a transaction, and mapping an active participant that stands for a security token to an agent.
    BalpConstants
    Canonical URLs of the AuditEvent profiles defined by IHE BALP.
    CreateAuditEvent
    A basic AuditEvent profile for when a RESTful Create action happens successfully.
    DeleteAuditEvent
    A basic AuditEvent profile for when a RESTful Delete action happens successfully.
    ExportAuditEvent
    The AuditEvent the disclosing side of a privacy disclosure records.
    ImportAuditEvent
    The AuditEvent the receiving side of a privacy disclosure records.
